error.insufficient_scope: The OAuth client must have devices:core:read and devices:routes:read access
error.invalid_auth: The OAuth client ID or secret is invalid or revoked

user.title: Connect a Tailscale tailnet
user.description: Create a read-only OAuth client on the [Trust credentials page]({trust_credentials_url}) with **Devices > Core: Read** (`devices:core:read`) and **Devices > Routes: Read** (`devices:routes:read`).

data_description.tailnet: The tailnet DNS name, organization name, or `-` shorthand.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Tailscale Trust
reauth_confirm.description: The credential for `{tailnet}` was rejected or lacks a required scope. Create or select a read-only OAuth client on the [Trust credentials page]({trust_credentials_url}) with Devices Core Read and Devices Routes Read, then enter the replacement credentials.
